Compton_fit_domain: 2≤kT≤300keV, eta≤7; eta<-10 uses nondegenerate limit, within table uses full fit. Both electron and positron contributions evaluated with actual EOS populations and physical eta_plus=-eta_minus-2/theta. Pair contribution is a componentwise extension of electron fit, flagged diagnostic.
limitations: Grey Rosseland sensitivity does not establish LTE, spectral emission or multigroup transport.
Classical ff opacity has no degeneracy/ion-correlation/relativistic/plasma-frequency correction; only comparison scale.
The source EOS includes equilibrium electron-positron pairs but fully ionized ideal ions and no Coulomb/ionization correction.
Sparse representative states establish scale, not extrema of fitted opacity throughout trajectories.
